newsitem.title: USA: Valujet bondholders okay Airways merger.
newsitem.headline: Valujet bondholders okay Airways merger.

text.p: ValuJet Inc, parent of ValuJet Airlines, said Wednesday it has received approval from a majority of its bondholders to proceed with its merger with AirWays Corp, parent of AirTran Airways.

ValuJet said that for purposes of receiving the consent fee only, the consent solicitation deadline has been extended until 1700 on August 11, and applies to all holders of record of the 10-1/4 percent notes as of the close of business on July 22.

ValuJet Chief Financial Officer Steve Nevin said that with bondholder approval now in hand, the discount airline company can move forward to gain the required final shareholder and regulatory approvals for the merger.
In the all-stock merger with Orlando, Fla.,-based competitor that was announced last month, ValuJet will be renamed AirTran Airlines.
The two airlines will operate separately under a holding company, AirTran Holdings, but will be able to share overheads.
